docs.title: Original Content Vault
docs.text:
Welcome to the Original Content Vault!

This site acts as a database of all my OC related stuff, such as the stories and individual characters. Everything can be found here and will be updated regularly.

Interested in catching up with the main portion of the story? Feel free to pick whatever story you'd like to read first:

Part 1: Accident Zero

Part 2: Zero War

Part 3: Revengeance

Part 4: Reborn

docs.title: Chapter 1
docs.text:
A mysterious girl named Laura is transported to a new reality called "Reality Zero," home to the powerful Zero Point. It has specifically chosen her as its protector, the one who would control all aspects of reality, time and space, and keep the Zero Point safe from harm. Unfortunately for Laura, she materializes inside a highly secure bunker owned by a secret organization. Quickly realizing her unique nature, the organization subjects her to a series of cruel experiments, testing the limits of her abilities.

One day, she is thrown into the Zero Point itself, where its power awakens her full potential, granting her the abilities of the Chosen One. Soon after, a mysterious woman frees her from her cell, giving Laura the chance to escape. Wasting no time, she unleashes her newfound powers and destroys the bunker, an event that becomes known as "Accident Zero."

Finally free, Laura explores her new world and soon discovers that she is trapped in a mysterious loop. While most lose their memories after 22 minutes, she retains hers and takes full advantage of this anomaly. With her abilities, she breaks free from the loop but, surprisingly, chooses to return, drawn to the thrill of the experience.

One day, a massive purple cube appears, making its way toward a location called Loot Lake. Lonely and seeking companionship, Laura develops an attachment to the cube, affectionately naming it "Kevin." Though its true purpose is to destroy the island and serve the faction known as The Last Reality, it also seeks out a specific individual to exploit. After dissolving into Loot Lake’s waters, Kevin resurfaces and eventually explodes, leaving behind fragments of itself. Laura, deeply affected by its destruction, retrieves a shard as a keepsake. She forges it into her first self-made weapon, a scythe, called "The Darkstrike Scythe." Unbeknownst to her, this is all part of The Last Reality's plan to corrupt and recruit her into their ranks. Slowly, their influence begins to take hold.

Later, Laura encounters the mysterious woman who freed her. She reveals herself as Demi Kaneko, a former member of the secret organization that imprisoned Laura. At first, Laura does not recognize Demi, and a fight ensues, a habit Laura has developed when meeting new opponents. Demi, unwilling to hurt her, stays on the defensive, dodging attacks. However, when she makes one misstep, Laura severs her right arm with the scythe. As Demi collapses, she utters something that triggers a flood of memories in Laura. Overcome with emotion, Laura breaks down in tears, finally realizing who Demi is. Filled with guilt, she ceases fighting, allowing Demi to bring her temporarily back from the darkness that took over. Demi, once her caretaker, now becomes the mother figure she never had.

Time passes, and Demi notices something is wrong with Laura. Her behavior is off, and her health has declined ever since the battle known as "The Final Showdown," where a colossal mech fought a sea monster, leaving the Zero Point destabilized. Seeking answers, Demi contacts an old enemy now an ally, The Scientist. Together, they discover that Laura’s health is directly linked to the Zero Point and worsened by the corruption seeping into her. Fortunately, The Scientist has a solution. A special purifier bracelet designed to cleanse corruption and enhance abilities. However, the materials needed to construct it are scarce. As Demi and Laura embark on their quest to gather the necessary components, The Scientist warns Demi of a plan to reset the Zero Point by crashing a meteor into it, triggering a cosmic reset. Laura, feeling an obligation to stop them, attempts to intervene but is powerless. The reset is carried out successfully, restoring balance but at a cost. Laura falls into a deep coma, unable to withstand the shock of the Zero Point’s destruction.

docs.title: Chapter 2
docs.text:
Months pass, possibly even a year, before Laura finally awakens. However, her corruption has worsened, and the Zero Point is once again unstable because of some big cosmic event involving a bunch of heroes fighting off a very big entity that tried to consume the Zero Point. While she was unconscious, Demi worked as a special agent for Midas, exchanging her services for resources to help complete the purifier bracelet. Overjoyed at Laura's return, Demi believes they can now finish their mission together.

Unfortunately, The Imagined Order, the secret organization behind Laura’s original captivity, sees the Zero Point’s unstable state as a reason to intervene. They deploy their Elite Guard, consisting of Sakuya, the combat expert; Jade, the scientist; and their leader, Orion, the pro-hunter. These formidable Elite Agents are tasked with eliminating anyone meddling with the Zero Point. On a secret patrol, Sakuya was able to spot Laura and Demi. From that day forward, Laura and Demi were hunted by Orion and Sakuya, while Jade was working on different projects in the background in an attempt to finally take down their targets.

As Demi and Laura evade their relentless pursuers, Demi and Sakuya's sibling rivalry reignites. Meanwhile, Orion focuses on capturing Laura, intending to harness her power to overthrow his own leader, Geno. Despite the relentless attacks, Demi and Laura successfully retrieve a very important material needed for the purifier bracelet, the metal for its frame.

All was going well for the Elite Guard, but their mission got interrupted by a sudden alien invasion. The extraterrestrial force, led by The Last Reality, seeks the Zero Point for themselves. The Imagined Order, now preoccupied with defending the island, temporarily abandons their pursuit of Laura and Demi. The aliens are hostile to all, except for Laura for some strange reason. Their lack of aggression toward her is unsettling and was a sign of something being off.

After finding out that the final component needed for the bracelet is an energy containment unit, Demi makes up a plan to retrieve it from the only place that could have one, the alien mothership. However, what Demi did not expect was that their mission was all predicted and went according to the Last Realities carefully crafted plan. It was all a trap. As soon as Laura steps inside the mothership, she is captured, and Demi is thrown out, left to watch in horror as the mothership explodes, releasing countless purple cubes onto the island.

A week later, The Last Reality launches a full-scale invasion, revealing their trump card, a dark, corrupted version of Laura. With the full power of the Guardian of time and Space at their side, they were basically unstoppable. Determined to save Laura, Demi locates the last missing piece of the bracelet and confronts the corrupted Laura. Their battle is intense, but Demi soon notices Laura’s had a big weakness. All but two emotions remained. Anger and fear. Demi is able to exploit this void of emotions by appealing to what Laura wanted most, feeling beloved and cared for. In the end Demi did not need a special device to solve Laura’s problems. All she needed was some love from a carrying parent. Something Demi would happily provide.

Even though the corruption is gone, their struggle is far from over. The Cube Queen herself arrives, determined to finish what she started.Laura and Demi, now together on the same side again, are able to put up a good fight. But in the end this was not enough. With one powerful attack they are shot far away from the island, surviving by landing into the deep oceans surrounding the island. Demi and Laura are eventually rescued by The Seven, who help them escape to a new island. Though they have not won the war against the IO just yet, for now, they are free. At last, Laura and Demi can live in peace as mother and daughter, if only for a short while.

The End (of Part 1)

docs.title: Chapter 3.1
docs.text: After the events of the previous story, Demi and Laura find themselves in a life-threatening situation, nearly drowning in the vast ocean surrounding the island as they watch it flip over. Fortunately, they're rescued just in time by some old acquaintances: The Seven. This group is determined to free the Zero Point from the Imagined Order’s control, and they want Demi and Laura’s help to achieve that goal. Laura, however, is hesitant. The Seven were responsible for putting her in a coma for an entire year. Though, she does agree to help since they share a common enemy. Demi also faces some initial distrust due to her past as a member of the IO Elite Guard, but she quickly proves her loyalty and value, earning their trust by letting her actions speak for her.

docs.title: Chapter 3.2
docs.text:
The Imagined Order launches a full-scale invasion on the newly discovered island, triggering an all-out war with The Seven. Demi and Laura, now aligned with The Seven, who call themselves the Resistance, prepare for a final stand. Their mission: defend the island, end the IO’s reign, and free the Zero Point once and for all.

The battle is intense. The Resistance manages to reclaim large portions of the island, pushing back against the IO’s forces. But the fight is far from over. The IO retaliates by sending in their Elite Guard. With their might and power they were able to quickly turn the tide of battle. When the Resistance plans a mission to retake Tilted Towers, they choose Laura to lead the charge since she was powerful enough to retake an area on her own. She succeeds in reclaiming the area, but her victory is short-lived. She ran into Sakuya and Orion. In a brutal and unforgiving battle, Laura is ultimately defeated and captured. She was no match for the combined forces of Sakuya and Orion.

As the IO’s grip weakens, they resort to a final, desperate measure: a doomsday device called The Collider. Designed by Jade, the Elite Guard’s lead scientist, the device is powerful enough to destroy the entire island and everyone on it. Jade intends to use Laura as the energy source for The Collider, exploiting her infinite Zero Point energy output. Laura endures horrific torture, comparable to the suffering she experienced years ago, as Jade attempts to extract the Zero Point's power from within her.

When Demi learns of Laura’s capture, she immediately proposes a rescue mission. But The Seven refused as they focused on the larger war effort. Frustrated and unwilling to let Laura suffer and potentially die, Demi takes matters into her own hands. Relying on her past experience as a spy and Elite Guard member, she infiltrates Covert Cavern, the IO’s central base of operations. There, Demi not only discovers where Laura is being held but also uncovers intel about The Collider. Before she can act however, she walks straight into a trap set by her sister, Sakuya. Initially, Demi hesitates to fight back. But she has no choice. The fight is gritty and relentless, with each sister using every dirty trick they can to gain the upper hand. Eventually, their battle leads them into Jade’s lab, where Laura is imprisoned in an incubation chamber. In a moment of quick thinking, Demi tricks Sakuya into attacking the chamber, unintentionally freeing Laura. 

As Laura begins to collapse, Demi catches her and makes a run for it, carrying her on her back. Demi fights off waves of enemies during their escape, determined to protect Laura at all costs. It seems they might actually make it, until Orion appears, waiting for them at the exit. Calm and cold, he congratulates Demi on her effort, but says he has “some cleanup to do.” Exhausted, Demi tries to stand her ground, but it’s clear they’re no match for Orion in their current state. As he charges forward, Demi dodges, but too late realizes she wasn’t the target. Orion strikes Laura instead, killing her in a single, devastating blow. He shows no remorse. If he couldn’t harness her powers, no one would.

Demi is shattered, both by grief and guilt. Fueled by rage, she fights back with everything she has, but her energy is nearly gone. Even with the boost her anger gives her, she’s unable to land any meaningful blows. Orion leaves her alive, for now, telling her that her time will come in the future. But for now, he has other business to take care of. So he left.

All that remains of Laura is a fragment of glowing energy. Demi returns to the Resistance, delivering the terrible news and revealing what she’s learned about the IO’s final plan.

(Insert “Zero War” comic series and the “Collision” live event here for further context)

The Resistance ultimately wins the war. The Zero Point is saved. The island is safe... for now. But for Demi, the victory is hollow. They won, but at a cost she hadn’t been willing to pay. Grieving and guilt-ridden, Demi distances herself from the others. She spends months obsessively searching for a way to bring Laura back, chasing any lead she can find. Each one leading to a dead end. Eventually, she finds herself alone at the edge of the island, staring out over the ocean. For the first time since Laura’s death, Demi feels truly powerless. As the sun sets behind her, she whispers into the fading light, “I’m sorry, Laura,” before stepping into the darkness, leaving herself, and the world, to wonder whether they had truly won anything at all.

The End (of Part 2)

docs.title: Bio
docs.text: Eldest twin daughter of the Minamoto clan, she was raised and trained to become an elite warrior. Now a fugitive from the very people she once swore loyalty to, she seeks a better life beyond duty and bloodshed. Her original mission was to watch over and control the “Omni-being,” a task she carried out without question, until she could no longer endure witnessing the suffering inflicted upon the young girl. Defying her orders, she set the child free and chose to protect and take care of the girl herself.

docs.title: Bio
docs.text: A young girl from Gaia, chosen to be the Zero Point’s Chosen One. After a difficult childhood, she vowed to protect the omni-verse from harm, determined that no one else should have to endure the suffering she once faced. With a direct connection to the Zero Point, she possesses an infinite well of energy that never runs dry, fueling her space and time abilities to do good. When paired with her Breaking Point ability, which amplifies her strength fiftyfold, defeating her becomes nearly impossible. She's essentially the strongest mortal out there.

docs.title: Inspiration
docs.text:
Matter and anti-matter. They don't mix well. Far from it. It's to a point where both cannot exist at the same time and if they do, it basically results in heavy destruction whenever the two come into direct contact with each other. Now, Laura is the Zero Point Guardian. The "Omni-Being". The one to control both time and space. What if she fought someone wielding anti-matter? The perfect counter. It will be a fight both parties will not and cannot survive.

Now, that faithful day has come for Laura to deal with the being wielding anti-matter. It's a fierce battle where both suffered heavy injuries, but purely because Laura was marginally stronger, she was able to survive the encounter… for now at least. Because of this fight, Laura was left in very bad shape and became terminally ill. The anti-matter was literally destroying her from the inside.

But, to her surprise, she found a young infant left in all the rubble from her battle. The child of the anti-matter wielder. Laura could not bear the thought of leaving a child alone like that, so she did what made the most sense to her at that moment and took her in as her own. Just like her mother did for her 450+ years ago. She knew the risk but she did it anyway.

Now skip forward a few years. The infant grew to be Laura's eldest daugther. The next in line to wield the title of "Omni-Being" and the one taking over Laura's mission for when the time comes. Sadly, this time came faster than expected as Laura became very sick and was unable to do her job as a protector, but also as a mother. For years, the daugther searched for methods to cure her mother. One day, the daughter found out who she really was and discovered a shocking truth. Laura was slowly dying of anti-matter poisoning and she made it worse because she too holds the power to wield anti-matter. She was devestated. Why did her mother keep this a secret from her? If she actually knew more about herself, her parent(s), and her power, she would have been able to possibly control it and at the very least gotten to squeeze more time with her mother out of it. She gave it one more shot. One more solution to cure her mother. And somehow… it worked? A week went by and Laura was walking around like nothing happened. The daugther was reliefed and happy that her solution worked. One night as Laura and her daugther were looking at the sky, Laura suddenly collapsed. The daughter was quick to catch her and brought Laura to a safe place for some rest. Laura died later that night. The solution to her illness wasn't a proper solution at all and did in fact not work. Laura's body gave up. It knew it could not win the war anymore so it stopped trying. (Real thing that happens btw)

Laura's daughter was devestated. After all, she believed this to be her own fault. If only she knew about Laura's illness earlier. If only she knew sooner who her actual parents were. If only she knew about her powers If only she was STRONGER. If only she was... in CONTROL.

Laura's death lead to the daugthers downwards spiral. A pursuit of power and control. It starts off as some mild manner of research to better understand anti-matter and it somehow leads to some less than moral methods to reach the peak of that power and once crossing the line to reach that ultimate power, she has a mental breaking point where she gets drunk off the knowledge and power she's obtained and goes on to use it to force people to stay in line. She took Laura's mission seriously, but in her own twisted way. Laura wanted an omni-verse with no conflict, no wars, no suffering, while maintaining people's free choice and freedom. The daughter wants to achieve the same thing. But instead of freedom, she takes the extreme route and falls back on total control. If she had total control, Laura wouldn't have died. But if she had total control over everything, nobody would die under her watch ever again. No more wars, no more suffering, no more conflict. Only total control for the one wielding ultimate power.

docs.title: Bio
docs.text:
Former royalty and the highest-ranking member of The Imagined Order’s Elite Guard. Just before he was crowned the rightful ruler of his kingdom, The IO invaded and conquered his reality in their quest to build the perfect civilization. Feeling robbed of his birthright, he vowed to take back what was his by any means possible.

During his tactical ascent, his ego took another hit when he witnessed a power far greater than his own. The realization that someone out there is stronger leaves him bitterly unsatisfied. He now vows to absorb this ultimate power at any cost. If he can't have it to create and rule his perfect world, nobody can.
